summary_zh: 该插件将Spotify Portal集成到Claude Code、Codex、Cursor和pi等编码代理环境，提供Portal CLI工作流：配置认证、搜索软件目录与技术文档、生成服务简报、运行只读诊断、安全调用Portal操作，并创建、运行和排查Fleetshift shift及从完成运行打开PR。
audience_zh: 适合使用Claude Code、Codex、Cursor或pi，并通过Portal CLI查询软件目录、了解服务归属与健康状况、执行Portal操作或管理Fleetshift的开发者与工程团队。

evidence.quote: Bring [Spotify Portal](https://portal.spotify.com) into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and pi.
- Set up the Portal CLI for your current coding-agent environment.
- Search the software catalog and technical documentation using natural language queries.
- Generate concise service briefings with available ownership, health, incident, and documentation details.
